title: Comprehensive Assessment of Historical Surface Air Temperature Simulations over Iran Using 51 CMIP6 Models
authors: Dina Yazdani, Azar Zarrin, Abbasali Dadashi-Roudbari, Abbas Mofidi & Brian Odhiambo Ayugi
abstract: This study evaluated 51 CMIP6 climate models to assess their ability to simulate historical surface air temperature across Iran from 1980 to 2014. The results showed that the Weighted Multi-Model Ensemble (WMME) outperformed individual models and the conventional ensemble, providing more accurate temperature estimates and reducing uncertainty in regional climate assessments.
